newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish jets take off from southeastern base.
newsitem.headline: Turkish jets take off from southeastern base.

text.p: Turkish F-16 jets took off from a base in the southeastern town of Diyarbakir on Thursday amid reports that Ankara was gearing up for an air-backed, cross-border incursion against Kurdish rebels in northern Iraq, witnesses said.
Witnesses saw a number of F-16s take off from the Diyarbakir base, but could not say how many.
Military officials in Diyarbakir would not say where the aircraft were headed.

Diyarbakir residents said heavy military preparations were in progress near Turkey's porous border with Iraq. The increased activity follows Ankara's announcement that it was preparing to set up a security cordon inside northern Iraq to halt Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) infiltration.

A high-ranking military official told Reuters earlier there could be a sudden, air-backed attack against PKK targets in northern Iraq. But Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller denied an incursion was imminent.
